newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian August OTC turnover rises sixfold.
newsitem.headline: Croatian August OTC turnover rises sixfold.

text.p: Croatian over-the-counter market turnover rose sixfold in August to 8.1 million German marks, the Varazdin Market reported on Monday.
It said some 6.3 million marks accounted for a single transaction with 19,013 shares in Djakovo-based firm Cetera.
Total volume more than doubled to 59,218 units in 26 firms. Some 4,000 were shares in companies undergoing privatisation which have yet to be fully paid.
Prices of nine stocks rose, seven fell and six were unchanged. Four firms, including Cetera, Adriatic Marinas ACI, shipper Tankerska Plovidba and Bjelovarska Banka traded for the first time.
Apart from Cetera, food processor Podravka was the most actively traded with 12,500 shares sold at 50-65 marks each.

Hotelier Jadranturist, whose shares rose to 45 from 31.10 marks, led gainers. The biggest loser was Adriatic pipeline operator Janaf, falling to 550 from 610 marks a share. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
